children.text: Designer. Director. DJ. Twenty-three years of making things people remember.

Benjamin Arnedo works across graphic design, brand strategy, video, UX, and marketing — fuelled by a bicultural lens (Argentine-born, Brisbane-based), an obsessive attention to detail, and the belief that the best ideas come from the room, not just from one person in it.
He's led studios, taught at universities, and delivered for everyone from government agencies to startups. He brings the idea you didn't expect, then stays up late making sure it's perfect.
He also sings. Not badly, apparently.
